purpose: Reduce source size while retaining normal FPS public APIs and native Linux performance. This review removes or rejects old internal paths; no new numerical algorithm or external implementation was introduced.

existing_sources.details: The Linux/GCC native_log branch immediately precedes the removed legacy LogTransform branch with the same runtime conditions.
Standalone component retained unchanged; now explicitly included by its direct component unit test.
Existing inverse_newton8 implementation was compared with the already-existing five-transform generic Newton fallback. The slower generic replacement was rejected.

cached_fastest_reference_note: No fresh Yosupo ranking request was needed for deletion of unreachable or unused paths. Existing native algorithm provenance remains in prior FPS benchmark reports.
